inputs.52.text: Stylish 1980s Japanese gothic OVA anime character design with the elegance of a fashion illustration: razor-thin, wiry black ink lines in which every contour breaks into straight segments and sharp corners, elongated figures about nine heads tall with small heads, long necks and long tapering hands, pointed chins and sharp jawlines, long narrow almond eyes under a single sharp upper lash line, hair drawn as long fine separate strands, hard angular cel shadows cut like paper in deep indigo and blue-black, a restrained palette with deep crimson and lamp-gold accents. Character reference of a tall, gaunt Victorian detective in his late forties with an elongated, elegant figure about eight heads tall and long, thin limbs: a narrow, sharply angular face with high cheekbones, hollow cheeks, a thin aquiline nose, thin firm lips, a pointed chin and long, narrow, austere pale grey eyes under straight dark brows; short black hair slicked straight back close to the skull from a high forehead, cut short at the nape. He wears a deep indigo silk dressing gown with a dark crimson sash, open over a white high-collared shirt, a black waistcoat and charcoal trousers, with black leather slippers. He stands upright in a three-quarter view turned toward screen left, arms relaxed at his sides, a calm, cold, composed face. Plain flat pale blue-grey background, even soft frontal light, the figure filling the frame from head to feet.
